latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ai-face-merge skill.
- Blend two faces into a single realistic portrait using the WeShop OpenAPI.
- Supports secure API key handling with environment variable support.
- Endpoints for running merges, polling status, and uploading images.
- Allows optional custom text guidance and batch image generation (1–16 results).
- Detailed usage instructions and security recommendations included.
